title: Default-agent message queue
description: AGENT-QUEUE-1: the reply to the queue routes. `POST /v1/agent/default/chat/queue {request_id, text}` - the composer's Send while a turn runs: codex 0.160's own durable queue (`thread/queue/add`, experimental) keeps the words and starts them, in order, when the turn ends (after a Stop they wait). `POST …/chat/queue/{id}:send` - Send now: into the running turn (`thread/queue/delete` then `turn/steer`; `delivery: "steered"`), between turns started as a turn of its own (`thread/queue/start`; `"started"`), or - when the turn ended in between - back on the queue first in line (`"queued"`). `POST …/chat/queue/{id}:edit {text}` - new words in its place (`thread/queue/update`). `POST …/chat/queue/{id}:delete`. `queue` is always the queue now (as the snapshot's). An approval is never queued. Refusals: `409 agent_queue_unavailable` (this codex has no queue: steer instead), `409 agent_queue_item_gone` (it started or was removed meanwhile), `409 agent_command_while_working` (`/plan`, `/compact`, `/review`, `/diff` wait for the turn to end), `409 request_conflict`, `400 invalid_task`. Native and web credentials.
